posts.title: You can't commit what Git can't see: keeping agent exhaust out of your repo
posts.description: Agent notes and scratch files want to live next to your repo, but .gitignore is a promise, not a guarantee. Keep them structurally outside the worktree.

posts.title: Beyond login: encrypting data with passkeys and WebAuthn PRF
posts.description: The WebAuthn PRF extension turns a passkey into an encryption keystore. How pknotes derives keys from a Face ID tap, and what that can't protect.

posts.title: My "Deploy to Cloudflare" button disabled auth
posts.description: A Deploy to Cloudflare button turned my local-dev config into production secrets — and shipped copies of my app with admin auth off. A postmortem.
